open_questions: Exact algorithm of FUN_08068578 (running sum used in FUN_08068784) is not present in the provided decompiled excerpt.

ROM-resident constants _DAT_08068b04, _DAT_08068b14, uRam08068b08, _DAT_08068b40 consumed by FUN_08068af0 are unresolved - their numeric values are needed to know which table-row tag values are considered 'valid'.

The header_text_block at offset 0 does not decode to one consistent English phrase under any single whole-string or per-word byte-reversal rule tried; individual substrings (KNIL/EHT/SDROW) strongly suggest a scrambled title/build tag but the exact scrambling rule is unresolved.

No sample with actual gameplay progress (a played, saved file) is available yet; all fields beyond the six INIT sentinels and the one populated 16-byte table block at offset 0xE0 are completely unverified (all 0xFF in this capture).
Exact byte sizes of the two unidentified table slots at offsets 0x90 and 0xB0 are inferred only from gaps between sentinels, not from an explicit size field read in code.

func_0x080689e0 (integrity check called from FUN_08068884 during load) is referenced but not included in the provided save_related_functions.c seed set, so its role is only inferred from call position.
